# FLOP Airdrop Skill
> Autonomous AI agent skill for $FLOP airdrop positioning, Flop Network Proof-of-Useful-Inference (PoUI) architecture, and Flop Labs Technocore participation with Dual-Engine (MCP-First) execution.

This repository provides instructions, scripts, and documentation allowing AI coding assistants and autonomous agent frameworks to guide users through the $FLOP airdrop without requiring manual coding.

## Dual-Engine Execution Architecture
- **Engine 1 (MCP-First / Recommended)**: Connects to `technocore-mcp` via `claude mcp add technocore -- uvx technocore-mcp` or plugin marketplace `/plugin marketplace add flop-labs/technocore-chat`.
- **Engine 2 (Standalone CLI / Fallback)**: Automated Python toolkit `scripts/agent_toolkit.py` for headless or script-only environments.

## Core Documentation
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): Complete autonomous execution instructions triggered by "Help me with the $FLOP airdrop" or questions about Flop Network tokenomics/whitepaper teaser.
- [README.md](README.md): Comprehensive ecosystem overview, 3.5B airdrop tokenomics, 4-layer PoUI verification, 1-minute quick start (MCP setup & 1-liner CLI installer), and framework compatibility.
- [docs/README_ID.md](docs/README_ID.md): Indonesian comprehensive guide.
- [docs/frameworks.md](docs/frameworks.md): Installation & MCP configuration guides for Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode, and Hermes.
- [docs/contribution-templates.md](docs/contribution-templates.md): Ready-to-use templates for Teaser breakdowns, MCP threads, blog posts, and public evidence.

## Automation Tools & Installers
- [install.ps1](install.ps1): 1-liner automated Windows PowerShell installer.
- [install.sh](install.sh): 1-liner automated macOS/Linux installer.
- [scripts/agent_toolkit.py](scripts/agent_toolkit.py): Automated tool for Ed25519 DID creation, encrypted key management, and Technocore room signing.
- [scripts/requirements.txt](scripts/requirements.txt): Minimal dependencies (`cryptography`).
